summary: One client takes RELIANCE from LTP to Quote to Depth and back down: one registration at the broker for all of it and one unregistration at the end, and after each change the frames of the mode held.

notes: The web publishes every subscription from its packet stores every 500 ms (motilal_adapter.py _poll_market_data); web.json holds the poll after each push, the desktop sends a frame when a packet changes what a subscription reports.

The web's adapter registers the scrip again for each new mode and unregisters it when any one mode is let go (MotilalWebSocketAdapter.unsubscribe calls unregister_scrip, which also drops the scrip's stores), so live the broker stops streaming a mode the client still holds; the glue keeps pushing, so web.json shows what the web publishes from the packets that follow. The desktop keeps one registration while any mode holds the scrip (feed::bridge, MotilalFeed::mode_change_frames).

deviations.reason: Before Motilal's day OHLC packet (G) the web sends open, high, low and close as 0 (quote.get(k, 0) in _normalize_quote_data), values it never received; the desktop leaves them out until the G packet (docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md: a missing value is not a measured zero).

Motilal's last-trade packet carries the last traded quantity and the average price, and the web's Quote dict sends them, but its Depth dict drops them (motilal_adapter.py _normalize_depth_data): lost data. Motilal sent no open interest for this cash scrip (no m packet; a cash scrip has none and its last-trade packet's OI slot is 0); the web's Depth dict sends oi 0 from a default (_normalize_depth_data: result['oi'] = 0 without an m packet); the desktop leaves it out.

Motilal has sent book level 1 only; the web pads the four levels that never arrived with integer zeros ({"price": 0, "quantity": 0, "orders": 0}, _normalize_depth_data), invented levels; the desktop sends the level received (lead decision 2026-11-09: no invented level).
